scope: Local output/research catalog in this checkout, including Git-ignored session records. Separate worktrees and tracked research documents outside this catalog are not included.

method.entries: Use hp_sim5_research.archive.catalog_entries, resolving aliases so each directory is counted once.
method.documents: Count only report.md and research.md directly within catalog entries. Do not recursively count retained source snapshots or copies in subdirectories.
method.words: Count Unicode word tokens with regex \b\w+\b in the report.md files, including Markdown tables and code. The figure rounds this count to thousands.
method.interpretation: Document counts overlap. Entries include unfinished sessions and tooling checks; these are not counts of completed scientific studies or successful experiments.

figure_generation: Matplotlib, with all numbers taken from the saved count snapshot
